description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) 'LDAPEmployeeSearchFilterParams' used for encapsulating search filter parameters related to LDAP employee searches within the OrangeHRM system. It contains private properties for various employee identifiers and contact details, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for LDAP employee search filter parameters, including employee number, ID, emails, license number, and social security or SIN numbers.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number, or null if not set.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID, or null if not set.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email, or null if not set.

methods.name: getDrivingLicenseNo
methods.description: Returns the driving license number, or null if not set.

methods.name: getOtherId
methods.description: Returns the other ID, or null if not set.

methods.name: getOtherEmail
methods.description: Returns the other email, or null if not set.

methods.name: getSsnNumber
methods.description: Returns the SSN number, or null if not set.

methods.name: getSinNumber
methods.description: Returns the SIN number, or null if not set.
